query: I have a last-minute trip coming up, so I need to order a few things that will all arrive quickly. First, I'm looking for something from Anta in size 42 and a Light Grey color; since it's a rush order, I want a popular item with more than 950 total reviews and a transport time of less than 2. Next, I need a men's item for myself from Under Armour in Dark Green, which also has to have a transport time of less than 2. I'm also getting a very highly-rated product from the brand Salomon. To ensure its quality, it must have more than 550 five-star reviews, with fewer than 5 one-star and two-star reviews, and a transport time of less than 2 days. Finally, I need one more men's item from Anta in Beige, and I want to make sure it's definitely available, so the stock quantity must be more than 200.
